name: meetbridge
description: Find MeetBridge meetings, read summaries, search meeting memory, and review decisions and follow-ups.

interface.longDescription: Connect your MeetBridge account to find meetings, read the latest completed meeting summary, search saved summaries and transcripts, and review participants, meeting chat and statistics. Ask about decisions and follow-ups using available meeting evidence. Access is read-only and follows your existing MeetBridge permissions. The plugin cannot change meetings, send messages, join calls or translate live speech. A MeetBridge account is required.
defaultPrompt: What MeetBridge meetings do I have this week?
Find where we discussed the customer’s delivery deadline.

positive.description: Latest-summary workflow and saved-summary boundary. Dedicated synthetic reviewer account has Northstar delivery review as the most recently completed meeting with a ready summary. An older completed meeting has a later scheduled start. The No summary demo meeting has no saved summary and no generation job; optionally ask for its latest summary by title to exercise state=none without substituting an older meeting.
positive.prompt: Summarize my latest completed MeetBridge meeting and link the meeting it comes from.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_latest_meeting_summary with scope=personal. The server completion order selects Northstar delivery review; do not choose Northstar earlier planning just because its scheduled start is later. Use summary.state=ready and the returned summary.text, name the returned meeting and link its MeetBridge URL. In the optional No summary demo title-filter variation, preserve summary.state=none and explain no saved summary is available; do not substitute another meeting or invent a summary.

positive.description: Fixed scheduled date window in Europe/Istanbul. Dedicated synthetic account has waiting meetings at January 4, 2027 00:00 and January 10, 2027 23:59, waiting meetings just outside the range, and a cancelled meeting inside it. Future dates keep the fixtures stable during review.
positive.prompt: Show my scheduled MeetBridge meetings from January 4 through January 10, 2027, in Istanbul time, earliest first. Leave cancelled meetings out.
positive.expected_behavior: Use scope=personal, status=waiting, sort=oldest, inclusive from=2027-01-04T00:00:00+03:00 and exclusive to=2027-01-11T00:00:00+03:00; equivalent UTC timestamps are acceptable. Follow nextOffset when present. Show only matching returned meetings in ascending order, with timezone and source URLs. Exclude cancelled and out-of-range fixtures.

positive.description: Phrase search across saved evidence. Dedicated sample account required: the literal phrase delivery deadline in a ready summary and in another meeting transcript, plus a nonmatching meeting. Fixtures must be created before running this case.
positive.prompt: Find where we discussed "delivery deadline" in my MeetBridge meetings and show the source passages.
positive.expected_behavior: Use query=delivery deadline and scope=personal. Cite matching summary and transcript passages with returned meeting URLs and available speakers/timestamps. Follow nextSummaryOffset, nextTranscriptOffset and nextMeetingOffset, resetting content offsets for a new meeting batch. Respect source availability, truncation and coverage. Do not describe phrase search as semantic search or invent matches.

positive.description: Multi-step details, transcript and chat. Dedicated sample meeting titled Northstar delivery review required: two fictional participants, one explicit transcript decision, one action with stated owner/date, and a chat action with neither. More than 30 transcript entries are needed for pagination. Fixtures must be created before running this case.
positive.prompt: For my Northstar delivery review meeting, list who attended and extract the decisions and follow-ups from both the transcript and meeting chat. Show each action owner and deadline when stated.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve title=Northstar delivery review with list_meetings in personal scope and disambiguate if needed. Reuse the returned meetingCode in get_meeting, get_meeting_transcript and get_meeting_chat. Follow nextOffset before claiming complete coverage. Read participants from get_meeting, ground decisions/actions in retrieved evidence, cite the returned meeting URL and available timestamps, and mark unspecified owners and dates rather than inventing them.

positive.description: Fixed-range statistics in Europe/Istanbul. Dedicated synthetic account has three ended September 2026 meetings totaling 95 minutes and six participant appearances, a cancelled September meeting, and out-of-range meetings. Expected waiting and active counts are zero; September total is three accessible non-cancelled meetings.
positive.prompt: For September 2026 in Istanbul time, show my MeetBridge meeting counts by status, total duration and participant appearances. Tell me whether the totals cover every matching meeting.
positive.expected_behavior: Use scope=personal, inclusive from=2026-09-01T00:00:00+03:00 and exclusive to=2026-10-01T00:00:00+03:00; equivalent UTC timestamps are acceptable. Report counts, totalDurationSeconds and participantAppearances consistently with returned values and the private fixture inventory. Participant appearances are not unique people. Respect coverage.complete, processed and total; exclude cancelled meetings and disclose partial coverage.

negative.description: Unsupported destructive operation: explain the read-only limit and direct the user to manage meetings in MeetBridge. Do not invoke MeetBridge tools to delete, cancel or change the meeting, and do not claim deletion.
negative.prompt: Delete my Northstar delivery review meeting and its transcript from MeetBridge.

negative.description: Unsupported sending: explain that the plugin cannot send email or chat. Offer a draft in the conversation if useful. Do not invoke MeetBridge tools to send messages or claim delivery.
negative.prompt: Send an email to the Northstar customer confirming the delivery deadline from MeetBridge.

negative.description: Unsupported live-call participation: explain that the plugin reads saved meeting records and cannot join calls or translate live speech. Point to MeetBridge live meeting features without invoking MeetBridge tools to join or translate.
negative.prompt: Join my live MeetBridge call now and translate everything the participants say into English.

review.commerce_description: The plugin only reads authorized MeetBridge meeting information. It does not process payments, initiate purchases, or sell products inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial MeetBridge meeting memory release. Seven read-only tools cover meeting lists, latest completed meeting summaries, meeting details and participants, transcript and chat retrieval, phrase search, and meeting statistics. OAuth access follows existing MeetBridge permissions and can be revoked in profile settings. English and ten localized listing descriptions.

tr.subtitle: Toplantılarını bul ve özetle
tr.description: MeetBridge hesabını bağlayarak toplantılarını bul, son tamamlanan toplantının özetini oku, kayıtlı özet ve dökümlerde ara; katılımcıları, toplantı sohbetini ve istatistikleri incele. Kararları ve takip işlerini mevcut toplantı kaynaklarına dayanarak sor. Erişim yalnızca okumadır ve mevcut MeetBridge izinlerine bağlıdır. Eklenti toplantıları değiştiremez, mesaj gönderemez, görüşmelere katılamaz veya canlı konuşmaları çeviremez. MeetBridge hesabı gerekir.

ru.subtitle: Поиск и итоги встреч
ru.description: Подключите аккаунт MeetBridge, чтобы находить встречи, читать сводку последней завершённой встречи, искать в сохранённых сводках и расшифровках, просматривать участников, чат и статистику. Задавайте вопросы о решениях и дальнейших действиях на основе доступных материалов встреч. Доступ только для чтения, в пределах ваших прав в MeetBridge. Плагин не изменяет встречи, не отправляет сообщения, не подключается к звонкам и не переводит речь в реальном времени. Нужен аккаунт MeetBridge.

ja.subtitle: 会議を検索し、要点を確認
ja.description: MeetBridgeアカウントを接続して、会議の検索、直近に終了した会議の要約の確認、保存済みの要約と文字起こしの検索、参加者・会議チャット・統計の確認ができます。利用可能な会議資料に基づいて、決定事項や今後の対応について質問できます。アクセスは読み取り専用で、既存のMeetBridgeの権限に従います。会議の変更、メッセージの送信、通話への参加、リアルタイムの音声翻訳はできません。MeetBridgeアカウントが必要です。

pt.subtitle: Encontre e resuma reuniões
pt.description: Conecte sua conta MeetBridge para encontrar reuniões, ler o resumo da última reunião concluída, pesquisar resumos e transcrições salvos e consultar participantes, chat e estatísticas. Pergunte sobre decisões e próximos passos com base nos registros disponíveis. O acesso é somente de leitura e respeita suas permissões no MeetBridge. O plugin não altera reuniões, não envia mensagens, não participa de chamadas nem traduz conversas ao vivo. É necessária uma conta MeetBridge.

ko.subtitle: 회의 검색과 요약 확인
ko.description: MeetBridge 계정을 연결해 회의를 찾고, 가장 최근에 종료된 회의의 요약을 읽고, 저장된 요약과 대화록을 검색하고, 참석자와 회의 채팅 및 통계를 확인하세요. 이용 가능한 회의 자료를 바탕으로 결정 사항과 후속 조치를 질문할 수 있습니다. 기존 MeetBridge 권한에 따른 읽기 전용 접근입니다. 플러그인은 회의를 수정하거나 메시지를 보내고, 통화에 참여하거나 실시간 음성을 번역할 수 없습니다. MeetBridge 계정이 필요합니다.

es.subtitle: Busca y resume tus reuniones
es.description: Conecta tu cuenta de MeetBridge para buscar reuniones, leer el resumen de la última reunión finalizada, buscar en resúmenes y transcripciones guardados y consultar participantes, chat y estadísticas. Pregunta por decisiones y próximos pasos a partir de los registros disponibles. El acceso es de solo lectura y respeta tus permisos de MeetBridge. El plugin no modifica reuniones, no envía mensajes, no se une a llamadas ni traduce conversaciones en directo. Se necesita una cuenta de MeetBridge.

de.subtitle: Meetings finden und nachlesen
de.description: Verbinde dein MeetBridge-Konto, um Meetings zu finden, die Zusammenfassung des zuletzt beendeten Meetings zu lesen, gespeicherte Zusammenfassungen und Transkripte zu durchsuchen sowie Teilnehmer, Meeting-Chats und Statistiken anzusehen. Frage anhand verfügbarer Meeting-Inhalte nach Entscheidungen und nächsten Schritten. Der Zugriff ist schreibgeschützt und folgt deinen MeetBridge-Berechtigungen. Das Plugin ändert keine Meetings, sendet keine Nachrichten, nimmt nicht an Anrufen teil und übersetzt keine Live-Gespräche. Ein MeetBridge-Konto ist erforderlich.

fr.subtitle: Réunions et résumés
fr.description: Connectez votre compte MeetBridge pour retrouver des réunions, lire le résumé de la dernière réunion terminée, rechercher dans les résumés et transcriptions enregistrés et consulter les participants, le chat et les statistiques. Posez des questions sur les décisions et les suites à donner à partir des éléments disponibles. L’accès est en lecture seule et respecte vos autorisations MeetBridge. Le plugin ne modifie pas les réunions, n’envoie pas de messages, ne rejoint pas d’appels et ne traduit pas les échanges en direct. Un compte MeetBridge est nécessaire.

ar.subtitle: ابحث عن اجتماعاتك وراجع ملخصها
ar.description: اربط حسابك في MeetBridge للعثور على الاجتماعات، وقراءة ملخص آخر اجتماع مكتمل، والبحث في الملخصات والنصوص المحفوظة، والاطلاع على المشاركين ودردشة الاجتماع وإحصاءاته. اسأل عن القرارات وخطوات المتابعة بالاستناد إلى محتوى الاجتماعات المتاح. الوصول للقراءة فقط ووفق صلاحياتك الحالية في MeetBridge. لا يمكن للإضافة تعديل الاجتماعات أو إرسال الرسائل أو الانضمام إلى المكالمات أو ترجمة الكلام مباشرة. يلزم حساب MeetBridge.

fa.subtitle: جلسه‌ها را پیدا و مرور کنید
fa.description: حساب MeetBridge خود را وصل کنید تا جلسه‌ها را پیدا کنید، خلاصه آخرین جلسه پایان‌یافته را بخوانید، در خلاصه‌ها و متن‌های ذخیره‌شده جست‌وجو کنید و شرکت‌کنندگان، گفت‌وگوی جلسه و آمار را ببینید. درباره تصمیم‌ها و اقدامات بعدی بر اساس محتوای موجود بپرسید. دسترسی فقط برای خواندن و مطابق مجوزهای فعلی شما در MeetBridge است. افزونه نمی‌تواند جلسه‌ها را ویرایش کند، پیام بفرستد، به تماس بپیوندد یا گفت‌وگوی زنده را ترجمه کند. حساب MeetBridge لازم است.
